messages:
Alex (AE): Prospect wants BYO-HSM POC. Requirements: monthly rotation, signed HSM attestation blobs monthly, 48h rollback window, and explicit SOW saying Redwood never has access to unwrapped KEKs. Can we confirm and give a ballpark uplift?
Ruth (Solutions): Yes. Two supported patterns: proxy (Redwood forwards to customer KMS over mTLS) or enveloping (customer supplies wrapped DEKs). Proxy needs HA tunnels; enveloping needs a wrapped-key upload workflow.
Ben (SE): For engineering we'll need an attestation metadata schema. Proposal: signer_id, hsm_serial, report_sha256, signature_b64, timestamp, ceremony_id. Simple JSON we can validate.
Maya (CryptoOps): Acceptance: vendor-signed attestation blob + SHA256 fingerprint + HSM serial + timestamp. For split-custody, accept N-of-M signatures but customer must define canonical aggregation. On rotation: we need atomic swap semantics and an in-flight drain window. I'll write a 1-page runbook.
Jo (Legal): Contract notes: we can include "no long-term access" clause and KEK-loss carve-out. Need to define "access" and require the customer to retain primary attestation blobs for audits; Redwood will retain verification hashes only. Also require emergency rekey runbook if 48h rollback is requested.
deploy-bot: Staging proxy tunnel created (2x) for poc-bank in us-east-1. Latency probe queued.
Alex (AE): Pricing ask: example for 120k tokens/day please (proxy vs envelope).
Ruth (Solutions): Ballpark: envelope = +7-10% uplift (integration + segregation). Proxy with HA tunnels + egress = +30-40% uplift. Final quote depends on throughput and rotation cadence; I'll prepare a small calc.
Ben (SE): I'll add the attestation upload endpoint and wrapped_dek upload schema to the integration doc.
Maya (CryptoOps): Runbook draft in 24h, will include fields we capture and cutover steps.
Jo (Legal): I'll draft SOW language (non-access, attestation acceptance, retention, liability carve-outs) and post for review.
Alex (AE): Great. Next: Ruth to send cost calc + two architecture diagrams; Jo to post draft SOW; Maya to post runbook; Ben to update integration doc. I'll update the customer after we have artifacts. :thumbsup:
